verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe a full webhook subscription system: creating subscriptions with subscription_types (gusto-docs-56), verifying via a token before events are sent (gusto-docs-71), HMAC signature verification (gusto-docs-23), specific events like payroll.paid (gusto-docs-16/22/49/59), and a health-check endpoint (gusto-docs-57). This is well-documented first-party API capability suitable for AI-native/event-driven integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of webhook reliability and a broader catalog of subscription event types beyond payroll.paid.
